# Natural Parallel Test

> A Claude Code plugin that stress-tests plans against nature by shared mechanism rather than resemblance. It decomposes a plan into ten mechanisms, searches seven levels of nature for systems solving the same problem under comparable constraints, refutes weak analogies with a separate adversarial reviewer, scores twelve durability principles, and returns one of four classifications.

The governing rule: do not ask whether the plan *looks like* something in nature. Ask whether nature has solved the same problem under comparable constraints, and what mechanism allowed that solution to endure.

The framework measures structural durability under uncertainty. It does not measure whether a plan is worth doing, affordable, legal, ethical, or wanted — and "natural" is never an argument for desirability, since nature also sustains parasitism, cancer, and mass extinction.

Install with `/plugin marketplace add cocodedk/natural-parallel-test` then `/plugin install npt@natural-parallel-test`. Commands are `/npt:test`, `/npt:worksheet`, `/npt:score`, `/npt:challenge`, and `/npt:analogues`.

## Method

- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/cocodedk/natural-parallel-test/blob/main/plugins/npt/skills/natural-parallel-test/SKILL.md): the eight-step procedure, the candidate schema, the twelve scored principles, and the four classifications
- [Step 1 — problem statement](https://github.com/cocodedk/natural-parallel-test/blob/main/plugins/npt/skills/natural-parallel-test/references/01-problem-statement.md): restating a plan as a problem so the proposed solution stops controlling the search
- [Step 2 — mechanisms](https://github.com/cocodedk/natural-parallel-test/blob/main/plugins/npt/skills/natural-parallel-test/references/02-mechanisms.md): the ten mechanisms, their probes, and the absent-versus-not-applicable distinction
- [Step 4 — validity tests](https://github.com/cocodedk/natural-parallel-test/blob/main/plugins/npt/skills/natural-parallel-test/references/04-validity-tests.md): same problem, similar constraints, comparable mechanism, relevant scale — with worked failures
- [Steps 7 and 8 — scoring](https://github.com/cocodedk/natural-parallel-test/blob/main/plugins/npt/skills/natural-parallel-test/references/05-scoring.md): per-principle 0/1/2 anchors, classification bands, and the five overrides that beat the score
- [Step 6 — limits and fallacies](https://github.com/cocodedk/natural-parallel-test/blob/main/plugins/npt/skills/natural-parallel-test/references/06-limits-and-fallacies.md): where analogies break, the naturalistic fallacy, and rationalizations to resist

## Reference

- [Analogue library](https://github.com/cocodedk/natural-parallel-test/blob/main/plugins/npt/skills/natural-parallel-test/references/03-analogue-library.md): catalogued natural systems across physical, cellular, organism, social-species, ecosystem, evolutionary, and cosmic levels — each with its mechanism, failure mode, transferable principle, and the point where it stops being valid
- [Report template](https://github.com/cocodedk/natural-parallel-test/blob/main/plugins/npt/skills/natural-parallel-test/references/07-report-template.md): the fixed output shape, so two assessments of the same plan are comparable
- [Worked examples](https://github.com/cocodedk/natural-parallel-test/blob/main/plugins/npt/skills/natural-parallel-test/references/08-worked-examples.md): three full runs — an organisational plan, a software platform, and a policy programme — landing on three different classifications
